answer: Beacon-Pledged Identity 1) Each participant, acting as a fable, deposits a small, refundable fee of 0.01 units into a communal treasury. 2) At dawn, a randomly selected beacon from a verifiable random function signals, creating a unique, auditable timestamp. 3) Participants submit a cryptographic proof linking their identity to this dawn beacon, pledging their staked fee. Zenith is the point of verification. Cost: $0.01 x N. For 1000 identities, cost is $10. Failure: If the random beacon generator is compromised.
